scenarioConnectionModel.explanation: The batch socket preserves 16 stable cell identities while DataManager and the exchange adapter share the one unique SeriesKey/descriptor.

scenarioConnectionModel.binancePhysicalUpstream: one path-per-stream connection for each unique descriptor
scenarioConnectionModel.explanation: The browser unions work onto one batch socket. The capacity snapshot is authoritative when interval planning adds base-series prerequisites; Binance stays path-per-stream, while OKX may multiplex up to 32 descriptors in this shard.
The additive client transport does not imply unsafe exchange multiplexing: Binance retains one physical K-line path per descriptor and OKX uses one bounded cross-symbol shard.

okx.decision: cross-symbol K-line multiplexing enabled only inside a bounded shard
okx.reason: The official connection-level control and payload budgets are enforced. The public document did not provide a smaller K-line-specific descriptor count, so CandleScope freezes a conservative internal cap.

binance.reason: The current product spans market types and adapters; the audited Spot combined-stream contract alone does not prove safe parity for every existing K-line route.

rollback.procedure: Keep KLINE_BATCH_STREAM_ENABLED=0 and VITE_KLINE_BATCH_STREAM_ENABLED=0, or turn both back off. The frontend then uses the existing SharedKlineStreamCoordinator and /stream/klines_multi path.
